Painkiller RTX sets a new standard for how small teams can balance massive visual ambition with limited resources by integrating generative AI. By upscaling thousands of legacy textures into high-quality Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials—a process that would have traditionally taken years—the team dramatically reduced the burden of repetitive work.
